breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the instruction to treat bending stress as uniform was physically incorrect. It explicitly stated, 'The assumption that bending stress is uniform over the section depth is incorrect for pure bending; stress varies linearly with y.' It then proceeded to use the correct flexure formula (σ = My/I), which results in a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis, perfectly aligning with the ground truth's correction.
